## Handover notes

- `a01-orchestrator--agent-recovery`: - `to_agent` the replacement as an agent id (for example `A05`, never the slug). Fill `completed` (checkpointed work), `remaining` (the rest), `blockers` (why the first run died, if known), `constraints` (attempts left).
- `a01-orchestrator--budget-enforce`: - `to_agent` the agent id that resumes the task (for example `A05`). Fill `completed` (checkpointed work), `remaining` (unfinished work), `constraints` (annotated budget, "last requeue"), `decisions` (breach and why).
- `a01-orchestrator--conflict-arbitrate`: - `to_agent` the losing claimant as an agent id (for example `A06`). Fill `decisions` (winner and rationale), `constraints` (what it must follow), `blockers`, `open_questions` (appeal path).
- `a01-orchestrator--dispatch-ready`: - `to_agent` the task's agent id (for example `A05`). Fill `goal` (task goal), `constraints` (budget, lease seconds, claims), `remaining` (acceptance), `artifacts` (upstream results with digests).
- `a01-orchestrator--escalate-human`: - `to_agent` the `owner` from step 3 (an agent id, A01 or A14). Fill `goal` (decision needed), `blockers`, `decisions` (what was tried), `open_questions` (human options).
- `a01-orchestrator--gate-approval`: - `to_agent` the downstream consumer as an agent id (A12 for release work, else A01 for the next round). Fill `decisions` (approve or hold and why), `verification` (`verified` only when covered), `blockers` (missing gates), `remaining`.
- `a01-orchestrator--lane-join-review`: - `to_agent` `A09`, `task_id` the `rev` task. Fill `goal` (review the merged branch once), `artifacts` (merged branch, lane results with digests), `constraints` (one review for the whole plan), `remaining` (A09 gate steps).
- `a01-orchestrator--parallel-lanes`: - One handover per ready lane, `to_agent` the lane agent id. Fill `goal` (the slice acceptance), `constraints` (the paths, the branch, "do not review, do not merge"), `remaining` (lane work), `artifacts` (none yet).
- `a01-orchestrator--plan-decompose`: - Write for the first task in the order, `to_agent` its agent id (for example `A02`). Fill `goal` (that task's goal), `constraints` (risk class, budget integers), `decisions` (pattern and why), `remaining` (ordered task ids), `artifacts` (the plan snapshot with its digest, as in `skill://swarm-handover-emit` step 1).
- `a01-orchestrator--rework-loop`: - `to_agent` the producing agent id (for example `A05`). Fill `goal` (clear blocking findings), `blockers` (finding ids), `constraints` (loops remaining, last loop warning), `remaining`.
- `a01-orchestrator--static-plan-mode`: - `to_agent` `A01` for the next round, `task_id` the orchestration task (or the first queued task when A01 has none). Fill `completed` (replayed transitions), `blockers` (skipped entries), `remaining` (unreplayed queue), `open_questions`.
- `a01-orchestrator--status-report`: - `to_agent` the operator-facing owner (`A01` when unknown, as an agent id). Fill `completed` (done task ids), `remaining` (open tasks), `blockers` (escalated), `verification` (`verified` only when every row was confirmed in `orch_status.py`).
